import tensorflow as tf

    class_path = os.path.join(data_dir, class_name)
    if os.path.isdir(class_path):
        for file in os.listdir(class_path):
            file_path = os.path.join(class_path, file)
            ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1]
            if ext in valid_extensions:
                image_file_paths.append((file_path, class_name))

        decoded = tf.image.decode_image(img, channels=3, expand_animations=False)
        valid_file_pairs.append((file_path, class_name))
    except:

print(f"Total valid images: {len(valid_file_pairs)} out of {len(image_file_pairs)}")

img_height,img_width=200,200
batch_size=32

# Create class to index mapping
class_to_idx = {name: idx for idx, name in enumerate(class_names)}

# Convert class names to indices
labels = [class_to_idx[name] for name in class_names_list]

# Perform train-validation split
train_indices, val_indices = train_test_split(
    range(len(file_paths)), 
    test_size=0.25, 
    random_state=123,
    stratify=labels
)

val_labels = [labels[i] for i in val_indices]

print(f"Training images: {len(train_files)}, Validation images: {len(val_files)}")

    img = tf.image.decode_image(img, channels=3, expand_animations=False)
    img = tf.image.convert_image_dtype(img, tf.float32)
    img = tf.image.resize(img, [img_height, img_width])
